title: Static Broad-Ear Continuous-Trunk Elephant

Eleven closed editable meshes and three opaque matte untextured PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, head -Y and actual horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. One prop, zero scene; no tusks, tack, platform, person, facial rig or animation.
